new_value: Completed the cited scope and unblocked the broader host-test build on gcc-13. (1) frame.c:73 mic_length and :207 llsec construction, plus schnorr48.c:306 mic_selector: value-range-safe explicit casts replacing implicit promotion-then-narrow; delta review verified bit-exact equivalence for all inputs (LLSEC_MIC_LEN_SHIFT=2, mask 0x1c confines bits 2-4; mic_length enum 0..1; mic_selector field 0..7 with only the >1U check downstream). (2) test_common.cmake: per-source -Wno-conversion exemption for vendored monocypher*.c inside lichen_test_target (rule ordering verified last-wins after the global -Wconversion; only the two vendored sources match the ^monocypher regex; project-owned sources keep full -Wconversion discipline). This also unblocked schnorr48_interop (0 errors) in addition to the cited pair. (3) Validation on heft gcc-13: frame_test 18/18, schnorr48_test 9/9, schnorr48_interop builds clean. Remaining project-owned conversion sites (pubkey_to_iid main.c:305, coap_slot_coord.c:264, and the wider sweep) filed as the long-tail follow-up 8mgv; monocypher itself compiles clean under the exemption. 3-lens delta review verdict: delta code bit-exact, correctly scoped, fully verified.
